channel.title: Deadly 60
channel.desc: Wildlife presenter Steve Backshall is on a quest to meet 60 of the deadliest animals on the planet. Steve and his team are on a fun-filled, adrenalin-fuelled journey to find those animals most people spend their lifetime avoiding. When a Nile crocodile attacks a local girl in her own swimming pool, Steve decides to investigate these ancient reptiles and to judge for himself whether they deserve their deadly reputation. He pits himself against the mighty fish eagle as he tries his hand at diving for his supper, and takes to the South African skies to try and find one of Africa's most elusive predators, the awesome hunting dog.
